long_description:
Join us at Camp Outpost for a special yoga experience bringing together breath, movement and community.

We’ll kick things off with a 60-minute all-levels yoga class on the patio. After class, refresh with complimentary cucumber water and stick around to connect with your fellow yogis. Camp Outpost will be offering specials on food and drinks, giving you a chance to hang out, grab a bite, and soak up the vibes. Come for the yoga. Stay for the community. 

📍1811 S Alamo St, San Antonio, TX 78204

🧘 Kimberly, thecatandthecowyoga 

💚 $15 

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in San Antonio, Workshops in San Antonio.
